name: RentEscalationScheduleBuilder
tagline: Turn lease rent clauses into an approved, generated rent schedule – inside Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A complete lease rent schedule app in one PCF control: enter fixed steps, percent, fixed-amount and CPI increases with floor/cap collars, free rent, abatements and percentage rent as simple rules, and get the month-by-month and lease-year schedule, rent in force, rent at expiry, incentive value, net effective rent, compound escalation and a portfolio escalation calendar – with an approval workflow, Power Fx events and Dataverse / Power Pages Web API data modes.
features: Fixed steps, % increases, fixed-amount increases and CPI reviews with floor/cap, repeating every N months
Free rent and partial abatement windows prorated by day
Percentage rent over natural or artificial breakpoints
Generated monthly and lease-year schedule with step chart and CSV export
Net effective rent per year and per area, compound escalation, incentive value
Escalation and expiry calendar with alert window
Draft → In review → Approved → Active → Superseded workflow with rule checks
Inline editing, what-if preview, undo and confirmations
Annual, monthly or per-area rent basis
Demo mode with fictional leases, phone layout with bottom bar
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
